attacks.name: Panther Gauntlets
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
If this attack would deal one or more |!damage| it deals 1 |!damage| instead.
After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 3 or less, Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Sonic Crush
steps: After this attack is resolved the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.
|!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Super Genius
superPowers.body: When this character is attacking, it may use this superpower during the |*Calculate Success| step of the attack. If it does, it may choose to count |!block| results as successess |*instead| of |!hit| results.

superPowers.name: Upgrades
superPowers.body: While another allied character within |!range| 4 is attacking or defending, during the |*Modify Dice| step of the attack, this character may spend up to 3 |!power| to use this superpower. For each |!power| spent the allied attacking or defending character may reroll 1 of their attack or defense dice.

superPowers.name: Head of Wakanda R&D
superPowers.body: Whenever this character rolls dice, after the effect is resolved, it gains 1 |!power| if it rolled at least 1 |!failure|.
